cfg.prompt:
A knowledge-graph "second brain" desktop app, React Flow style, dark UI. Lay it out like a real app shell and build exactly these 24 areas, ONE region per agent (24 cols total), each placed to match its region hint:
- A01 app-shell (root frame), A02 top-command-bar (top), A03 command-palette (modal strip), A04 kb-explorer (left-top sidebar tree), A05 search-filters (left-bottom), A06 graph-canvas (large center), A07 note-node, A08 concept-node, A09 source-node, A10 cluster-node, A11 agent-node (small node cards on the canvas), A12 edge-system (edge legend), A13 minimap-controls (bottom-right overlay), A14 layout-switcher (top-right overlay), A15 context-menu, A16 hover-preview, A17 node-inspector (right panel), A18 markdown-editor (right panel), A19 activity-feed (right panel), A20 proposal-review (right panel), A21 ask-the-graph (right panel chat), A22 timeline-scrubber (bottom dock), A23 ingest-import (modal), A24 status-legend (status bar).
Use realistic labels and copy for a research knowledge graph. Pick the fitting ReUI component per region (tree, data-grid, timeline, code-block, badge, frame, stepper, autocomplete, rating, etc.).

- A01 app-shell (root frame), A02 top-command-bar (top), A03 command-palette (modal strip), A04 kb-explorer (left-top sidebar tree), A05 search-filters (left-bottom), A06 graph-canvas (large center), A07 note-node, A08 concept-node, A09 source-node, A10 cluster-node, A11 agent-node (small node cards on the canvas), A12 edge-system (edge legend), A13 minimap-controls (bottom-right overlay), A14 layout-switcher (top-right overlay), A15 context-menu, A16 hover-preview, A17 node-inspector (right panel), A18 markdown-editor (right panel), A19 activity-feed (right panel), A20 proposal-review (right panel), A21 ask-the-graph (right panel chat), A22 timeline-scrubber (bottom dock), A23 ingest-import (modal), A24 status-legend (status bar).
Use realistic labels and copy for a research knowledge graph. Pick the fitting ReUI component per region (tree, data-grid, timeline, code-block, badge, frame, stepper, autocomplete, rating, etc.).

regions.name: A01 app-shell
regions.brief: Desktop window chrome for 'Cortex — Second Brain': three traffic-light dots on the left, centered window title 'cortex.app · Predictive Processing', and a 1px surface border framing the entire shell below.

regions.name: A02 top-command-bar
regions.brief: Top command bar with a global search input 'Ask Cortex… (⌘K)' and dropdown hints, breadcrumb '/Predictive Processing/Feature Prediction', and right-side 'Ingest', 'Share' buttons plus a sync badge 'All nodes synced · 2m ago'.

regions.name: A03 command-palette
regions.brief: Command-palette modal strip listing quick actions: 'Create linked note' (⌘N), 'Find citations to Barak & Costa 2016' (⌘⇧F), 'Layout: Force-Directed' (⌘L), 'Tag selection #dopamine', each row with a left icon and right shortcut, keyboard-highlight on the first row.

regions.name: A04 kb-explorer
regions.brief: Left-top 'Knowledge Bases' sidebar tree: expandable 'Predictive Processing' (23) with children 'Active Inference' (9), 'Precision & Gain' (7), 'Free Energy Principle' (4), plus 'Motor Control' (11); show per-node document count badges and a +New root button.

regions.name: A06 graph-canvas
regions.brief: Large center canvas: faint dotted grid and vignette; a hub node 'Feature Prediction' near (720,320) with radiating links fanning left and right; bottom-left hint 'scroll to zoom · drag to pan' and top edge fades into the overlays.

regions.name: A17 node-inspector
regions.brief: Right panel 'Inspector — Feature Prediction' as a data-grid of properties (Type=Concept, Confidence=0.94, Sources=3, Updated=2d ago, Tags) with a sortable column header and a small '14 links' footer tab.

regions.name: A05 search-filters
regions.brief: Left-bottom filter builder beneath the tree: stepped chips 'node_type = concept', 'source_doi exists', 'last_updated > 30d', 'cited_by ≥ 5' composing a boolean query, with a live '12 results' count and a Reset link.

regions.name: A07 note-node
regions.brief: Primary note-node card 'Feature Prediction' on the canvas: title, 2-line body 'The cortex estimates future sensory states before they arrive…', a pin icon, tag chips 'CORE' and 'ACTIVE', and a '14 links' connection count.

regions.name: A08 concept-node
regions.brief: Concept-node 'Precision Weighting' as a rounded icon-tile with a brain glyph and a violet accent border (concept type), label beneath, and a small degree badge '7'.

regions.name: A09 source-node
regions.brief: Source-node pill 'Barak & Costa 2016 · PNAS' as a compact italic badge with a PDF file-type dot and hover affordance showing '347 citations' on hover.

regions.name: A18 markdown-editor
regions.brief: Right-panel 'Edit · feature-prediction.md' markdown editor as a Shiki-highlighted code block with line numbers, a 'Saved ✓' gutter and a Preview toggle; content reads '# Feature Prediction — the cortex encodes an expected stimulus…'.

regions.name: A10 cluster-node
regions.brief: Cluster-node 'Active Inference (9)' as a dashed-outline icon-tile group with a stacked-layers glyph and an 'expand' hint; sits at the left edge of the canvas.

regions.name: A11 agent-node
regions.brief: Small agent-node card 'Cortex-Agent · Summarizing' with a pulsing amber status dot and a tiny progress line 'ingesting 3/12 papers'; amber accent border to read as active/working.

regions.name: A12 edge-system
regions.brief: Edge-legend panel floating top-left of the canvas listing link styles with 24px line samples and toggles: solid blue 'derived-from', dashed violet 'contradicts', dotted gray 'co-cited'.

regions.name: A13 minimap-controls
regions.brief: Bottom-right minimap control (~96×96) showing a micro node-cluster thumbnail, accompanied by a vertical button stack: zoom +, zoom −, fit (⤢), and a 'Reset' text button.

regions.name: A14 layout-switcher
regions.brief: Top-right layout switcher as a horizontal stepper 'Force-Directed' (active, accent blue) · 'Layered' · 'Clustered' · 'Radial', each with a tiny 16px layout icon.

regions.name: A15 context-menu
regions.brief: Floating right-click context menu near the Feature Prediction node: 'Open', 'Add link to…', 'Set as hub', 'Pin position', a divider, then 'Archive' and a red 'Delete'.

regions.name: A16 hover-preview
regions.brief: Hover-preview tooltip card anchored near a node: 'Free Energy Principle (FEP)', one line 'Variational framework bounding posterior uncertainty — Friston 2010', with a '↳ 3 open tabs' hint and an 'Open ↵' affordance.

regions.name: A19 activity-feed
regions.brief: 'Recent' activity timeline in the right panel: '2h — Agent linked Feature Prediction → Precision Weighting', '1d — Barak & Costa 2016 ingested (24 sources)', '3d — Cluster Active Inference collapsed', each with a colored node dot and timestamp.

regions.name: A20 proposal-review
regions.brief: Proposal-review card 'Suggested links (2)': 'Feature Prediction —derived-from→ Active Inference' with [Accept][Reject] and '87%' confidence, plus 'Gain —contradicts→ Fixed-Weighting' at '79% confidence'.

regions.name: A21 ask-the-graph
regions.brief: 'Ask the Graph' chat panel: input field 'how is precision related to free energy?' and a streamed answer bubble citing '[1] FEP', '[2] Figs. 3' with a 'View sources (2)' chip above a send button.

regions.name: A22 timeline-scrubber
regions.brief: Bottom dock timeline scrubber spanning 'Q3 2023 → Q4 2024' with per-quarter tick marks, two draggable range handles selected to 'Aug 2024–Oct 2024', and a play button 'Annotate by time'.

regions.name: A23 ingest-import
regions.brief: Ingest-import modal 'Import sources' with a drop zone 'Drop PDFs / URLs / folders', a 3-item list (2 .pdf, 1 .url) each with a file-type icon, file size, and a 'Map to…' tag selector, plus Cancel and an accent 'Ingest 3' button.

regions.name: A24 status-legend
regions.brief: Bottom status bar of status badges: '● Connected' (green), '1,284 nodes', '3,012 edges', 'Layout: Force-Directed', and on the right '100% zoom' with a 'Auto-syncing…' spinner.

op.label: Micro node-cluster thumbnail: several accent and purple dots linked in a small c
